      Purchase options and add-ons

      • High-Quality Material: Crafted from lightweight, eco-friendly, and durable polyester fabric with full sleeves for 100% water protection. Suitable for both men and women, and compatible with various clothing styles.
      • Stay Dry & Comfortable: PU 2000MM waterproof coating ensures remarkable water resistance and quick drying, while the adjustable drawstring hood protects your face from the elements.
      • Versatile Use: Designed with a long body, large hooded cap, and foldable design, making it suitable for daily wear, walking, camping, hiking, trekking, travel, and water park activities.
      • One Size Fits Most: Full-length hooded raincoat with a size that fits Small to XL sizes, providing ample coverage even when worn with a backpack.
      • Portable & Compact: Features an easy-to-use zipper or snaps for quick wearing and can be folded into a compact size of (27 x 10 x 9 cm) and weighing only (350 grams), ensuring excellent portability wherever you go.

      How are ratings calculated?
      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      Customers say

      Customers find the rain poncho lightweight and appreciate its portability, with one mentioning it's great for riding scooters. The rain protection receives mixed feedback - while some say it's good for heavy Mumbai rain, others note it's not purely water resistant. Moreover, the water resistance is problematic as water seeps through and enters through the zipper, and durability is a concern with reports of it tearing on its own. Additionally, opinions on value for money are divided, with some considering it worth the price while others find it overpriced. The size also gets mixed reviews, with some finding it very good while others say it's too large.

      Product description

      Rocksport Waterproof Rain Poncho with Adjustable Hood and Sleeves for Men And Women II PU Coating 2000 MM(Maroon)This Poncho is made from light weight Nylon with 2,000 mm waterproof PU coating. The hood is comfortably large and neck is wide so that you can put it on and take it off with ease even if you are wearing glasses and a helmet. Cinch cords around the neck can be used to tighten reduce the exposed facial area. This poncho can be worn on top of your regular day pack. Because this product has been designed with utmost care and a lot of thinking we vouch for the fact that you will absolutely love it. This poncho keeps you dry from the rain when hiking or travelling outdoors. This waterproof rain poncho is the essential accessory during hikes, treks, camping and even for outdoor travels. Just slip it over your head and watch it slide effortlessly over your body to protect you and your gear from the rain. Made with abrasion resistance, fully sealed seam, it blocks even the tiniest water droplet from touching you, helping you remain dry and comfortable in outdoors during rains.
